newsitem.title: USA: HealthCor gets contract in Colorado.
newsitem.headline: HealthCor gets contract in Colorado.

text.p: HealthCor Holdings Inc said Wednesday it has a pact to provide respiratory services and home medical equipment for FHP International Corp, an operator of health maintenance organizations.
HealthCor said it will serve about 220,000 enrollees of FHP's health plan in Denver, Colorado.
Terms of the contract were undisclosed, but HealthCor said the business generated $6.5 million in 1996 revenue and that additional revenue growth is expected in 1997.
HealthCor provides comprehensive home health care services in the southwestern and central United States.

"We view this transaction as a major development," HealthCor said in a release. "Respiratory therapy improves our business mix by expanding the for-profit component of our business and sharply expands HealthCor's penetration of the Colorado marketplace."
FHP was recently acquired by PacifiCare Health Systems Inc.
